title: Event and State Management
summary: This module provides a robust event bus for managing event emission, registration, and processing, alongside mechanisms for tracking application runtime state and event records. It supports both synchronous and asynchronous event handling, including dependency management and state checkpointing.

nodes.label: Manage Event Flow
nodes.title: CrewAIEventsBus
nodes.description: The central singleton event bus responsible for registering handlers, emitting events, and orchestrating their execution, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous processing.

nodes.label: Define Base Event Structure
nodes.title: BaseEvent
nodes.description: The foundational class for all events within the system, providing common attributes like timestamp, type, source, and event correlation IDs.

nodes.label: Manage Event Scopes
nodes.title: event_scope
nodes.description: A context manager that establishes and maintains a hierarchical context for events, allowing for tracking of parent-child relationships between emitted events.

nodes.label: Handle A2A Push Notification Receipt
nodes.title: A2APushNotificationReceivedEvent
nodes.description: An event signaling the successful reception of a push notification from a remote Agent-to-Agent (A2A) system, including task and context details.

nodes.label: Record A2A Push Notification Send
nodes.title: A2APushNotificationSentEvent
nodes.description: An event indicating that a push notification has been successfully sent to a client's callback URL by the A2A server, detailing status and outcome.

nodes.label: Track A2A Agent Card Fetch
nodes.title: A2AAgentCardFetchedEvent
nodes.description: An event recording when an A2A agent's capabilities or metadata card is successfully retrieved, including details like endpoint, protocol, and caching status.

nodes.label: Signal Parallel A2A Delegation Start
nodes.title: A2AParallelDelegationStartedEvent
nodes.description: An event marking the initiation of a task delegated concurrently to multiple A2A agents, listing the target endpoints and task description.

nodes.label: Signal Parallel A2A Delegation Completion
nodes.title: A2AParallelDelegationCompletedEvent
nodes.description: An event marking the conclusion of a task delegated concurrently to multiple A2A agents, summarizing success/failure counts and results from each agent.

nodes.label: Signal A2A Context Creation
nodes.title: A2AContextCreatedEvent
nodes.description: An event indicating the successful creation of a new A2A interaction context, which groups related tasks or conversations.

nodes.label: Signal A2A Context Expiration
nodes.title: A2AContextExpiredEvent
nodes.description: An event indicating that an A2A interaction context has automatically expired due to its time-to-live (TTL) setting, detailing its age and task count.

nodes.label: Signal A2A Context Idle State
nodes.title: A2AContextIdleEvent
nodes.description: An event indicating that an A2A interaction context has become idle, meaning no activity has occurred within it for a configured period.

nodes.label: Signal A2A Context Completion
nodes.title: A2AContextCompletedEvent
nodes.description: An event indicating that all tasks within an A2A interaction context have reached a completed state, providing total task count and duration.

nodes.label: Signal A2A Context Pruning
nodes.title: A2AContextPrunedEvent
nodes.description: An event indicating the removal or deletion of an A2A interaction context, often due to expiration or explicit cleanup, detailing tasks and age.

nodes.label: Configure Checkpointing
nodes.title: _coerce_checkpoint
nodes.description: A utility function that automatically converts boolean checkpoint settings into a CheckpointConfig object and registers necessary event handlers for state saving.

nodes.label: Listen for Checkpointing Events
nodes.title: _on_any_event
nodes.description: A universal event handler that monitors all emitted events to determine if and when a state checkpoint should be triggered based on configured rules.

nodes.label: Record Event History
nodes.title: EventRecord
nodes.description: A data structure that stores a directed graph of all emitted events, automatically wiring edges based on event relationships like parent, triggered by, and previous events.

nodes.label: Deserialize Event Data
nodes.title: _resolve_event
nodes.description: A function responsible for validating and deserializing raw event data (e.g., from a dictionary) into the appropriate BaseEvent subclass for processing.

nodes.label: Reset Event System for Tests
nodes.title: reset_event_state
nodes.description: A utility function designed for testing environments to clear and reset the internal state of the event bus and event context for isolation between tests.

nodes.label: Prompt for Tracing Activation
nodes.title: on_first_execution_tracing_confirmation
nodes.description: A utility that checks if it's the first execution of CrewAI and, if so, prompts the user via CLI to enable tracing features.

nodes.label: Application Runtime State
nodes.title: RuntimeState
nodes.description: An external component representing the overall dynamic state of the CrewAI application, including active entities and the event record.

nodes.label: Execute Sync Handlers
nodes.title: ThreadPoolExecutor
nodes.description: An external thread pool executor used by the event bus to run synchronous event handler functions in a non-blocking manner relative to the main thread.

nodes.label: Execute Async Handlers
nodes.title: asyncio Event Loop
nodes.description: An external asynchronous event loop managed by the event bus to efficiently run non-blocking (awaitable) event handler functions.

nodes.label: Checkpointing Configuration
nodes.title: CheckpointConfig
nodes.description: An external configuration object that defines the parameters and behavior for how and when the system's state should be saved or checkpointed.

nodes.label: Command Line User Input
nodes.title: click.confirm
nodes.description: An external utility for interacting with the user through the command-line interface, typically for confirmations or input.

groups.label: Event Core
groups.title: Core Event Handling
groups.description: Components forming the fundamental event dispatch and management system, including the event bus, base event definitions, and context management.

groups.label: A2A Specific Events
groups.title: Agent-to-Agent Communication Events
groups.description: Specialized event types for tracking various stages and states within Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication and delegation processes.

groups.label: State & Checkpointing
groups.title: Runtime State Persistence
groups.description: Components responsible for managing the application's runtime state, recording event history, and implementing checkpointing mechanisms for state persistence.

groups.label: Development & Utilities
groups.title: Development and Setup Utilities
groups.description: Utility functions for development, testing, and initial setup, such as resetting event state for tests and prompting for tracing activation.
